    """Log a finding and its implication. If implication is None, assume it changes nothing."""
    print(f'⚠️  FINDING: {statement}')

        print(f'  ⇒ IMPLICATION: {implication}')
    else:
        print('  ⇒ IMPLICATION: No change to plan')
